text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: rolling runtime pin + fallback test across eu-west, us-east, ap-south. Start: 2024-06-18T02:00:00Z. Estimated impact: brief tail-latency increases, possible 503s during canary. Tagging #support ops.
Sanjay K.: Heads up — this will include a model pin for a small subset of Dedicated customers, right? Need to confirm scope for SLA notice.
Maria G.: Yes. Pin only for customers on 'v2024.3' group in eu-west/us-east. ap-south will be canary-only. No forced pin in Private deployments.
Katie (Support): Drafting customer-facing blurb now. Will include start time, affected regions, and mitigation steps. Want to keep it <3 sentences.
Leo - Eng Oncall: Canary in ap-south will run 15min, if error rate >1% we abort and fallback to previous model automatically. Rollback path: immediate unpin + route to pooled fallback model.
Sanjay K.: Can we get the exact fallback model name for the comms? Customers often ask for specifics.
Leo - Eng Oncall: Fallback model: rwd-infer/fallback-001 (quantized). Add note: "automatic fallback; no action required by customers".
Katie (Support): Statuspage snippet draft:
```
We will perform a rolling runtime update and model pin in eu-west and us-east on 2024-06-18 02:00 UTC. A small subset of Dedicated customers may see transient latency or short request failures. If issues are detected during the ap-south canary, we will automatically fallback to a compatible model. No action required from customers.
```
Maria G.: Add link to runbook and include expected duration per region (10-20 minutes). Also mention the support contact for escalations.
Katie (Support): Updated snippet with duration and runbook link. Also preparing email template for Dedicated customers with commit-level details.
Sanjay K.: Legal / revenue asked for SLA note — recommend: "We anticipate no SLA credit events; we will notify if this changes." Keep that language vetted by legal later.
ops-bot: Reminder: preflight checklist due in 60m. Items: rollback-tested, canary-runbook attached, statuspage draft posted, SOC aware.
Leo - Eng Oncall: Confirmed rollback tested on staging with the same quantized path. Can run an additional canary staging run pre-window if helpful.
Katie (Support): I'll post the statuspage snippet 2 hours before start and send Dedicated email 24h and 1h reminders. Drafts will be shared in #support-drafts for sign-off.
Sanjay K.: For customers with reserved Dedicated pools, we should include pinning schedule per-customer in the email (we can enumerate from the commit list). Maria, can you produce that mapping?
Maria G.: On it. Will export list and attach to the email template as a bullet list. ETA 45m.
Katie (Support): Final Q — should we include a short "what to expect" FAQ line about token billing during fallback (tokens still billed as normal)?
Leo - Eng Oncall: Yes include: "Requests served by fallback model will be billed at the same API rate tier; no unexpected billing changes."
Katie (Support): Great. I'll add that. Putting the draft in #support-drafts now :email:  
Sanjay K.: Thanks everyone. If no major objections in 30m we proceed with the planned comms cadence. :thumbsup:
